title: Resources
description: Editor aid for data/resources.json. The CI gate is scripts/validate-resources.mjs; keep this file in step with it.

url.description: The homepage, starting with https://. Plain HTTP is not accepted.

description.description: The full description exactly as it should render, trailing period and pricing parenthetical included.

section.description: The exact ## heading text this entry belongs under.

subsection.description: The exact ### heading text within the section, or null if the section has no subsections.
